items.title: CVE-2026-114938 RCE in OpenJDK: Everything You Need to Know
items.summary: Detect and mitigate Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938), a critical 9.2 RCE vulnerability affecting OpenJDK and major Java-based applications.
items.creator: Tomer Schwartz

items.title: Microsoft agent-framework Compromised: Credential Stealer Targets Azure and CI Pipelines
items.summary: On November 17, 2026 at 20:35 UTC, versions 1.26.1 & 1.26.2 of the Microsoft PyPI package agent-framework were published with an added credential stealer.  The package gets almost 200k downloads a month. The malicious versions have since been quarantined.
items.creator: Rami McCarthy
